anomalies: A1 PHANTOM EXTENTS: Trailer Dropdowns declares 1,048,576 rows (real 645); Motor Library declares 2,186 rows x 711 cols (real 628 x 649); Trailer Module declares 913 (real 695); FO Module declares 25,150 (real 25,102). Cause: whole-column formatting/data-validation.
A2 DATA ISLAND: FO Dropdowns col S has a >200-row gap; real extent 2206 not 768. Any importer using consecutive-empty-row cutoffs must use a large threshold or full scan.

A3 MULTI-ROW/BANNER HEADERS: Motor Library header is R4 (R1-R3 = audience banners + column ruler); Trailer Module has a column-number ruler at R3 mid-data; both sheets embed section banner rows inside the data range (Motor: banner in col C w empty col D; Trailer: col A).

A4 STALE CACHED FORMULA ERRORS: FO Module carries 155 '#N/A' Base Price and 38 '#N/A'/'#VALUE!' Sell cached values; Motor Library has stray '.'-filled option cells; these are frozen formula results, not live errors.
A5 STALE REFERENCE DATA: Motor Module hidden Yamaha_Dealer_Current is the Jul-2024 dealer price list while visible sheets carry Jun-2026 campaigns — do not import it as current cost.

A6 DUPLICATE KEYS: 51 Motor Library col-D codes duplicated (re-listed under twin/triple-rig + white-colour + campaign sections; rigging kit codes repeat up to 7x) — model code alone is NOT unique, needs section context or dedupe-by-priority; Trailer Module has 14 duplicated supplier codes and 2 duplicated display names.

A7 OBSOLETE-SECTION FO REFERENCES (HEADLINE): Boat Module Stabicraft rows reference FO codes that overwhelmingly resolve ONLY inside the FO Module's 'OBSOLETE OPTIONS' meta-section (row 19068+): '2350 - Supercab Adventure' 73 refs -> 12 active / 61 obsolete-only / 0 missing; '2350 - Supercab Sportfish' 57 refs -> 0 active / 57 obsolete-only; '2050 - Treker (Adventure)' 51 refs -> 0 active / 50 obsolete-only / 1 missing (STB-2050TREAD-219). The active Stabicraft section re-keys the same options to 10-digit numeric factory codes (e.g. 7552323012) and the Boat Module was only partially migrated; hidden empty 'Stabicraft' sheet is the vestige of the old source. Any importer joining Boat->FO must search the obsolete section AND build a legacy-key crosswalk, or the join loses ~80-100% of Stabicraft options.
A8 WHITESPACE-ONLY CELLS: Trailer Module spacer rows contain single-space strings — naive `is not None` row filters overcount; must strip.

A9 MIXED TYPES IN NUMERIC COLUMNS: Trailer 'Boat Size (Mtr)' mixes ints/floats/strings ('1450 Exp', '4.3'); Motor 'HP Rating' mixes numbers and 'n x HP'/'Electric' strings; FO 'Base Price' mixes numbers, 'TBC', 'POA', '-', '#N/A'.
A10 HP MULTI-ENGINE FORMAT: MPF writes '2 x 300' (lowercase letter x), HelmLogic lesson references '2 × 300' (multiplication sign) — parser must accept both.
A11 FO 'Matrix' column noise: 8 rows carry literal 'Matrix'/'MATRIX' header text; 265+2397 code rows have empty Matrix (brand inferable only from section banner above).
A12 'Factory Options - MU' header shares the 'Factory Options - NN' prefix (Boat Module col 267, a 29% markup cell) — regex for FO ref columns must anchor on trailing digits.
